us-cdc-evdorder.last_note: EXCLUSIVE. CDC port-health page updated 11 Sep 2026 16:31Z: a FIFTH Title 42 order was issued 11 Sep 2026, effective 5:00pm EDT Fri 11 Sep, in force 30 days (to ~11 Oct 2026). NOT YET in the Federal Register ('This Order will be published'). Read the primary PDF in full. MATERIAL LANGUAGE CHANGE: Ebola now described as 'confirmed present in DRC and, until recently, in Uganda'; Determination reads 'confirmed currently present in DRC and recently present in Uganda. There is a material risk that the outbreak will spread to South Sudan and again to Uganda.' First order to concede Uganda is clean and retain it on prospective-reimportation grounds. Data: DRC 6,779 confirmed / 3,267 deaths / 61 health zones as at 9 Sep (vs 4,318 / 2,011 / 41 zones at 9 Aug); contact tracing ~87% vs 95% operational threshold; true magnitude possibly 2-4x reported. THNs: L4 Ituri+North Kivu (from 4 Aug), L3 South Kivu/Haut-Uele/Tshopo, L2 rest of DRC AND ALL OF UGANDA. NAIROBI NAMED: order's factual basis lists Jomo Kenyatta International (NBO) and Addis Ababa Bole (ADD) among transit hubs providing pathways into the US, with BRU, DOH, DXB, IST. Issued with a 15-day comment period and 'subject to the outcome of an ongoing comprehensive public health risk assessment'. Signed Adm Brian Christine, Assistant Secretary for Health.
